description: Publish an artifact under a spec. Runs the full vibe-flow loop: spec_create + artifact_log + brand_match (optional) + compliance_check (optional) + drift_judge + drift_log. Returns verdict + next_action.

artifact_ref.description: Artifact reference for drift_judge. Required for the artifact-anchored path (recommended).

git_repo.description: Kind=git_sha: working dir for git cat-file.

max_bytes.description: Cap on resolved bytes; default 256 KiB, hard cap 4 MiB.

auto_save_decision.description: Default true (when DARK_MEMORY_V280=1). When true AND verdict=aligned, auto-create a kind=decision agent_memory row.

text.description: Artifact body (legacy; used by brand_match + compliance_check + legacy drift_judge). DEPRECATED for drift_judge — supply artifact_ref instead.

async_drift_check.description: Default false. When true, drift_judge runs in the background and vibe_publish returns immediately (verdict=pending); poll pipeline_status for the final verdict.

auto_drift_check.description: Default true. Set false to skip drift_judge.

tasks.description: Optional JSON-encoded array of VibeSpecTask objects. Pass the array as a JSON string; see vibe_spec for the structured form.

name: dark_memory_vibe_publish
